role: XCTest suite for DataPurgeService ('Delete All My Data'): report booleans and summary copy, stubbed remote-deletion success/failure, conversation/facts/disclaimer clearing, container sweep of unknown files and directories, UserDefaults sweep with the entitlement/migration/AppleLanguages keep rules, biometric reset and iCloud sync left off.
state: savedSettings: UserSettings? / savedDisclaimer: Bool (per-test restore of SettingsManager.shared)
toplevel: Every purge call injects deleteRemote so no real CloudKit zone deletion runs.

flags.text: Every test runs the real DataPurgeService.purgeAllUserData inside the app host against live singletons (SessionArchive.shared, CloudKitSyncManager.shared, SettingsManager.shared, AppDependencies.current stores): it sweeps the host's App Group, Application Support, Documents, Caches and tmp, every non-kept UserDefaults key in both suites, the AI-key Keychain items, delivered notifications and CloudKit local sync state. Only settings and the disclaimer flag are restored in tearDown, so every test class that runs later in the same process starts from a wiped app and swept defaults.

units.does: Class setUp: saves the process-global NSTimeZone.default into the class's OSAllocatedUnfairLock then sets NSTimeZone.default to TestTimeZone.utc for every test in the class.
units.entry: XCTest class-level setUp, run once before the first test in the class

units.does: Class tearDown: restores NSTimeZone.default from the saved value (when one was captured) and clears the lock.
units.entry: XCTest class-level tearDown, run once after the last test in the class

branches.cond: a saved time zone exists in the lock
branches.effect: true: NSTimeZone.default restored to it; false: default left as-is (UTC from setUp)
